cynefin.comment: Read cynefin-beta, optionally joined to its colon through directives. The bare spelling requires its own following boundary. Follows detection.md#the-detectors and cynefin.md#detection.

patterns.comment: Read a native YAML region from a three-dash opening fence to the first qualifying unindented closing fence. Follows cynefin.md#native-hidden-forms-and-eol.
Read a native ignored percent-brace region through its earliest brace-percent closer with a following whitespace or end-of-input boundary. Follows cynefin.md#native-hidden-forms-and-eol.
Read a native percent-pair comment up to physical line end or a separator-led common comment. Follows cynefin.md#native-hidden-forms-and-eol.
Read title lines and the colon-led or braced forms of accessibility metadata. Follows cynefin.md#strings-and-common-values.
Read the five fixed domain values. Follows cynefin.md#grammar and cynefin.md#ordered-units.
patterns.name: constant.language.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read an indivisible transition arrow. Follows cynefin.md#ordered-units.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.arrow.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read the transition-label separator. Follows cynefin.md#grammar.
patterns.name: keyword.operator.separator.colon.mermaid

patterns.comment: Read an item or transition-label string. Follows cynefin.md#strings-and-common-values.

cynefin-line-final-keywords.comment: Read the reserved accessibility description keyword when only padding and directives remain on its physical line, including after another complete unit. A later-line value receives its surrounding context's scopes. Follows cynefin.md#strings-and-common-values and common.md#a-directive-is-a-token-boundary.
